        count = match.group(1)
        # Set terminate_with_result to the count
        # But I can't set it here in the code; I need to output it in the JSON.
        # I'll store it and return later.
        # Since this is the last action, I'll print the count and then the function ends.
        print(count)
    else:
        # If no match, print the body text for debugging
        print('No review count found. Body text:')
        print(body_text)
    # Note: The act function doesn't return a value; it performs actions.
